## Headline
Build Your Process Once. It Runs Every Time.

## The Problem
Your BDC process exists in a training manual and in the heads of your best reps. When they're busy, steps get skipped. When they leave, the process leaves with them. Your CRM has workflow rules, but they can't assign an AI agent to make a call. They can't verify a lead in 5 seconds. They can't auto-schedule an appointment after a conversation. Your process depends on people remembering to do things — and people forget.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 30:25-30:42]

## The CXM Solution
CXM's visual workflow editor lets you build your entire lead handling process once — and it executes perfectly every time. Assign AI agents to handle the first call, the after-hours text, the day-three follow-up. Assign humans to the high-touch moments. AI watchers handle the admin: scheduling appointments, sending confirmations, updating your CRM. Your process stops depending on memory and starts depending on architecture.

## How It Works
1. **Define**: Use the drag-and-drop workflow editor to map your process. Lead arrives → AI verification call (5 seconds) → text confirmation → email with vehicle details → day-3 AI follow-up → human callback on day 5.
2. **Assign**: Each step gets an owner — an AI persona or a human. AI follows your prompts. Humans get tasks in their queue.
3. **Execute**: Every lead goes through the same process. No exceptions. No forgotten steps.
4. **Review**: AI generates summaries, scores calls, flags opportunities. Managers review outcomes, not checklists.

## Key Capabilities
- Visual no-code workflow builder
- AI and human steps in the same process
- Sub-5-second instant lead verification
- Auto-appointment scheduling after calls
- Nightly review of all open opportunities

## Who It's For
- GSMs who want consistent process execution
- BDC managers who need scale without headcount
- Dealers who've tried AI tools that "push notes but don't close the loop"

See your process automated. Schedule a workflow demo.
